##### Project general facts

Portside Square by Ellington Properties is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture is inspired by the rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers — Portside Residences I, II, and III — the project is defined by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that reflect natural light. The design creates a seamless connection between sea, sky, and structure, offering residences with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views that bring a sense of calm sophistication to everyday living.

The lifestyle at Portside Square is elevated by a comprehensive collection of amenities designed for wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents enjoy access to leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a fitness pavilion, and dedicated spa and sauna zones. Yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a children’s club create a balanced, community-focused environment, while jogging paths, garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges enhance the outdoor experience and reinforce the project’s waterfront character.

Interiors are finished with modern design and high-quality materials, combining natural textures with refined detailing to create elegant and comfortable living spaces. Equipped kitchens are seamlessly integrated with premium appliances, supporting both functionality and style. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully curated finishes.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
